test.create_query: CREATE TABLE sparse_vectors ( id UInt32, m_str Map(String, Float32), m_lc Map(LowCardinality(String), Float32), m_int Map(UInt32, Float32) ) ENGINE = Memory
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO sparse_vectors SELECT number, mapFromArrays(arrayMap(k -> concat('t', toString(k)), keys), weights) AS m, m, mapFromArrays(keys, weights) FROM ( SELECT number, arrayDistinct(arrayMap(i -> toUInt32(cityHash64(number, i) % 30000), range(64))) AS keys, arrayMap(k -> toFloat32((cityHash64(number, k, 1) % 1000) / 100), keys) AS weights FROM numbers(500000) )
test.query: WITH mapFromArrays(arrayMap(k -> concat('t', toString(k)), range(0, 30000, 750)), arrayMap(k -> toFloat32(k % 7 + 1), range(0, 30000, 750))) AS q SELECT sum(mapDotProduct(m_str, q)) FROM sparse_vectors

WITH mapFromArrays(arrayMap(k -> concat('t', toString(k)), range(0, 30000, 750)), arrayMap(k -> toFloat32(k % 7 + 1), range(0, 30000, 750))) AS q SELECT sum(mapDotProduct(m_lc, q)) FROM sparse_vectors
WITH mapFromArrays(arrayMap(k -> toUInt32(k), range(0, 30000, 750)), arrayMap(k -> toFloat32(k % 7 + 1), range(0, 30000, 750))) AS q SELECT sum(mapDotProduct(m_int, q)) FROM sparse_vectors
